name: HCA Gut Cell Atlas v1 Myeloid Lineage
description: Healthy and adjacent-to-disease control data from 27 gut single-cell RNAseq datasets were collected and integrated to form v1 of the Human Gut Cell Atlas myeloid lineage

labelsets.name: Prelim annotation
labelsets.description: Cell annotations (Prelim annotation) are based on the finest possible label that could be used to describe each of the ~500 clusters found during integration and subclustering

labels.name: Macrophages Cycling
labels.rationale: Coexpression of MKI67, STMN1, and often histones with macrophage core genes (C1QB, MS4A7) identify proliferating macrophages engaged in local self renewal or inflammatory expansion

labels.name: Macrophages Tissue Resident
labels.rationale: High C1QA, C1QB, C1QC, SELENOP and phagocytic/lysosomal programs point to the long lived tissue resident macrophages that are distinct from monocyte derived circulating lineages

labels.name: DC cDC2
labels.rationale: CD1C, CLEC10A, FCER1A, SIRPA, define antigen presenting type 2 conventional dendritic cells with CD11b positive identity and non crosspresenting functions

labels.name: DC cDC1
labels.rationale: Expresses CLEC9A, XCR1, DNASE1L3, and related cross presentation machinery, matching the canonical transcriptional program of type 1 conventional dendritic cells described in human mucosal and lymphoid tissues

labels.name: DC migDC
labels.rationale: LAMP3, CCR7, IDO1, CD40, CCL5, capture the antigen experienced, lymph node directed migratory DC state which has been repeatedly observed in barrier tissues
labels.ontologyAssessment: migratory DCs are a well described rare celltype relevant to mucosal biology that are increasingly being annotated in single cell atlases - they should have a cell ontology label!

labels.name: Monocytes
labels.rationale: These clusters have high CD14, FCN1, LST1, VCAN, and inflammatory chemokine/adaptive-interface genes, and include classical and nonclassical states. May be possible to further subdivide into classical/nonclassical subtypes

labels.name: doublets
labels.rationale: A Cell Annotation Platform (CAP) term used to identify a row in a “cell by gene” table that appears to contain combined data from a pair of cells rather than data from one cell and should therefore be discarded.

labels.name: Fibroblasts Follicular Dendritic Cells (fDC)
labels.rationale: Displays CR1, CR2, CXCL13, TNFSF13B, and complement receptor driven antigen retention machinery. These also express stroma lineage markers, making them easy to annotate within the myeloid lineage.

labels.name: Macrophages M2
labels.rationale: Expresses MRC1 (CD206), FOLR2, CD163L1, CD209, and other alternative activation metabolic genes, marking tissue repair and IL4/IL13 responsive programs

labels.name: Granulocytes Mast Cells
labels.rationale: presence of KIT, FCER1A, FCER1G could point to matured Mast cells with chymase, something to look out for here. In general, CPA3 and tryptase (TPSAB*) genes are highly expressed and unique to mast cell populations, making them easy to annotate in gut data

labels.name:
DC Monocyte derived dendritic cell
(MO DC)
labels.rationale: Shows MSR1, NPR2, and monocyte-to-DC transition markers, defining monocyte-derived dendritic cells arising under inflammatory differentiation

labels.name: Granulocytes
labels.rationale: Expresses granulocytic effectors including CLC, IL4 inducible modules, CPA3, and Fcγ receptor associated genes, hint at polymorphonuclear granulocytes distinct from mast cells. Obviously a big ? given difficulty in picking these up with typical droplet-based protocols
